e.title: NetworkFraud (BiRank/M2V/SAGE)
e.summary: 保险欺诈网络分析论文代码（EAJ 2024）：BiRank/Metapath2Vec/GraphSAGE 网络学习方法
e.body: NetworkFraud 是论文《Network Analytics for Insurance Fraud Detection - A Critical Case Study》（Deprez, Vandervorst, Verbeke, Verdonck, Baesens；European Actuarial Journal 2024，doi:10.1007/s13385-024-00384-6）的实验代码：实现论文中使用的多种网络学习方法（BiRank、Metapath2Vec、GraphSAGE 等）用于保险欺诈检测。对 RIAA：图神经网络×保险欺诈的研究实现（欺诈检测的关联分析）。与 [[insurance-reports-dnn]]（文本分类）、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、保险欺诈主题互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：EAJ 2024 论文代码（BiRank/Metapath2Vec/GraphSAGE 保险欺诈网络分析）
e.summary_en: Paper code for network analytics in insurance fraud detection (EAJ 2024): BiRank/Metapath2Vec/GraphSAGE network-learning methods
e.summary_hk: 保險欺詐網絡分析論文代碼（EAJ 2024）：BiRank/Metapath2Vec/GraphSAGE 網絡學習方法
e.body_en: NetworkFraud is the experimental code of the paper 'Network Analytics for Insurance Fraud Detection — A Critical Case Study' (Deprez, Vandervorst, Verbeke, Verdonck, Baesens; European Actuarial Journal 2024, doi:10.1007/s13385-024-00384-6): implementing the various network-learning techniques used in the paper (BiRank, Metapath2Vec, GraphSAGE etc.) for insurance fraud detection. For RIAA: a research implementation of graph neural networks × insurance fraud (relational analysis for fraud detection). Complements [[insurance-reports-dnn]] (text classification) and [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]. Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[insurance-governance]].
e.body_hk: NetworkFraud 是論文《Network Analytics for Insurance Fraud Detection - A Critical Case Study》（Deprez, Vandervorst, Verbeke, Verdonck, Baesens；European Actuarial Journal 2024，doi:10.1007/s13385-024-00384-6）的實驗代碼：實現論文中使用的多種網絡學習方法（BiRank、Metapath2Vec、GraphSAGE 等）用於保險欺詐檢測。對 RIAA：圖神經網絡×保險欺詐的研究實現（欺詐檢測的關聯分析）。與 [[insurance-reports-dnn]]（文本分類）、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]] 互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
